card_name: HDFC Bank Diners ClubMiles Credit Card
fee_details:
- Rs. 1,000 joining fee
- Rs. 1,000 annual fee
reward_structure: Reward points can be redeemed for air or partner hotels and various options including flights with Airways, Singapore Airlines, Trident Hotels, and Club Vistara.
key_highlights:
- A premium travel card with best-in-class or miles program.
- Redeem reward points for air through miles exchange programs.
- Free airport lounge visits to both domestic and international airports.
- Dining discounts at partner outlets.

benefits_features.Welcome gifts:
A welcome kit, plus you will get 1,000 reward points, which will be credited once the card is printed.
Also, for every reward point, you can earn 1,000 reward points as an annual bonus. However, this bonus is not applicable if the fee is waived off.
benefits_features.Annual Review: The annual fee on the card will be waived off if you spent Rs. 1 lakh or more in a year.
benefits_features.Travel benefits:
Book air tickets across more than 150 airlines and hotel rooms from a wide choice of hotels across brands/chains and enjoy special benefits.
Enjoy complimentary access to various year-to-year 25 domestic and foreign airport lounges and VIP/PBS worldwide.
Exchange HDFC CreditCard reward points for miles with leading airlines.
You will a complimentary insurance cover that protects you and your family.
Air accident coverage up to Rs. 1 crore.
Emergency medical expense coverage worth up to Rs. 25 lakh.
Credit liability coverage worth up to Rs. 85,000 in case of loss or delay of baggage.
Travel insurance coverage worth up to Rs. 85,000 in case of loss or delay of baggage.
benefits_features.Reward points Program:
Reward points (Diners ClubMiles, Citi Miles, etc.) are powered by the Miles Exchange Program.
You can earn 4 reward points per every Rs. 150 spent on the card.
Reward points can be redeemed for air miles with partner airlines and hotels including flights with Airways, Singapore Airlines, Trident Hotels, and Club Vistara.
1 reward point = 1 air mile.
Reward points also can be redeemed for gifts and vouchers from Citi's exclusive Reward Redemption Catalogue.
Points also can be exchanged for an air ticket or hotel bookings (HDFC Bank Diners Club website). 1 reward point = Rs. 0.58
benefits_features.Lifestyle privileges:
You can enjoy a discount of 15% and other benefits at some of the best restaurants in your city.
Get assistance for your travel needs by contacting a concierge, which is available 24/7.

how_tos.How to Apply for HDFC Diners ClubMiles C:
Apply for Diners ClubMiles Credit Card online by visiting HDFC Bank's website directly. Alternatively, you can also apply through BankBazaar to enjoy many partner benefits.
Follow the few steps mentioned below to apply for the card through BankBazaar:
Click the 'Check Eligibility' button on the page to establish your eligibility for the card.
If you're eligible, you will find the 'Apply Now' button below.
Click on it and enter the necessary details before submitting.
You would then be prompted to upload the documents. Upload them and click on 'Submit'.
You will receive the application number on your registered mobile number once you successfully submit the application. You can use the same number to check the status of your credit card application by clicking 'Track Application' on the website.

- Reward points also can be redeemed for gifts and vouchers from Citi's exclusive Reward Redemption Catalogue.

fees_and_charges.Cash withdrawal fee: 2.5% of the withdrawn amount or Rs.500
fees_and_charges.Cheques/demand draft processing charge:
- Cheque value of up to Rs.5,000 - Rs.25
- Cheque value of more than Rs.5,000 - Rs.50
fees_and_charges.Over limit charges: 2.5% of the over limit amount (minimum Rs.500)

miscellaneous: The HDFC Diners ClubMiles Card is offered by the bank to both salaried and self-employed individuals. The eligibility criteria/documents are different for the type of customers.

faqs.1. Is the reward rate different for HDFC: Yes, the reward rate that the cardholder is eligible for is different for both the credit cards offered by HDFC.
faqs.2. What is the minimum age requirement f: An individual must be minimum 21 years of age.
faqs.3. Do I pay for availing additional card: No, you can add cards without paying any fee.
faqs.4. What is the reward redemption fee?: For each reward compilation request, you would be charged Rs. 99.
faqs.5. Is the card available only for salari: No, it is available for both salaried and self-employed individuals.
